(adopted) Kinetic energy will be the energy source used for the device.
(adopted) The case should be doubly curved.
(adopted) The group will use an advanced chip to support the display and audio features.
(proposed) The design should include two versions: one with double curved and one with single curved housing.
(adopted) The product will be named The Real Remote, with copyright marking after Real.

The two participants began hands-on design on the smartboard, the group evaluated the product, and the board was saved to the project folder.
PM will show the design to management and create a new page on the board to prepare for management review.

ME will present the marketing presentation on trendwatching, ID will present the components design including energy sources and electronics, and UI will present the small example design and categorize everything for the menu, distinguishing simple vs advanced options.

PM will document that minutes capture decisions and actions made during the meeting, including adopting kinetic energy as the energy source, a doubly curved case, an advanced chip for display and audio, two versions (double curved and single curved), the product name The Real Remote, and proposed features like the flipping mechanism and one-handed operation.
